note: Exceptions determine when a rule that would normally apply gets overridden to N/A, or when unresolved applicability/evidence must produce REVIEW instead of a guess. Checked AFTER applicability, BEFORE evidence check. Unresolved date_role is handled separately in rules.json validation logic (type: presence_with_role), not here - it is an evidence-quality issue, not an applicability exception.

exceptions.reasoning: Country of origin is only a mandatory declaration for imported packages. Do not fail a domestic product for missing it.

If we cannot confirm whether the product is imported, do not guess. An unresolved applicability question must not silently become N/A (which would hide a possible violation) or FAIL (which could wrongly penalize a domestic product).
exceptions.status: PROPOSED - confirm with Person 1 whether MVP even attempts import-status detection, or whether it's always 'unknown' for MVP and this rule just always REVIEWs.

exceptions.reasoning: Best before/use by is only required for commodities that may become unfit for consumption over time (Rule 6(1)(da)). Non-perishable items (e.g. steel utensils, stationery) should not be failed for lacking this.
If perishability isn't confirmed, treat it as unresolved applicability, not N/A or FAIL.
exceptions.status: PROPOSED - same open question as import_status_unknown: does MVP classify product category/perishability at all, or is it always 'unknown'?

exceptions.reasoning: Unit sale price does not apply where RSP equals USP, on wholesale packages, on combination/group/multi-piece packages, or on e-commerce listings (see rule's legal_reference for sourcing on each exemption).
Applicability of unit sale price depends on package type and pricing, which may not always be determinable from the image alone. Do not guess.
exceptions.status: PROPOSED - confirm with Person 1/3 whether package-type classification (wholesale/combination/group/multi-piece) is in scope for MVP.

exceptions.reasoning: Dimensions are only meaningful for specific commodity categories, not all packaged goods.
If commodity category/relevance isn't confirmed, treat as unresolved rather than guessing N/A or FAIL.
exceptions.status: PROPOSED - confirm with Person 1/3 whether commodity-category classification needed for this is in scope for MVP.

exceptions.condition: colocation cannot be reliably determined from available bbox/image_geometry evidence
exceptions.effect: result = REVIEW (informational only - PCR-R11 is never scored regardless of outcome)
exceptions.reasoning: PCR-R11 is experimental. When the system can't reliably assess placement, it must say so (REVIEW) rather than defaulting to PASS or FAIL. This never affects the compliance score.

not_implemented_this_mvp: Multi-component/group package special handling beyond the unit-sale-price exemption already captured above (Rule 6(5)-adjacent area)
QR/electronic declaration as a substitute for printed declarations

Full sub-condition derivation for unit_sale_price applicability (wholesale vs combination vs group vs multi-piece vs RSP==USP) - MVP treats this as one upstream boolean; see PCR-R09 applicability note in rules.json
